content:
Leadership Ranking in the Global Market

November 2025 data shared by Statcounter clarified user preferences in the AI market. Globally, ChatGPT continues its leadership by a wide margin with an 81.84% market share. Despite competitors’ aggressive marketing strategies and integrations, no deep-rooted change is observed in user habits.

The global market share ranking is as follows:

  • ChatGPT: 81.84%
  • Perplexity: 11.06%
  • Copilot: 3.06%
  • Gemini: 2.97%
  • Claude: 1.06%
  • Deepseek: 0.01%

AI Usage Statistics in Turkey

Data from the Turkish market points to ChatGPT dominance above the global average. More than 90% of users in Turkey prefer OpenAI solutions as their primary AI tool. This rate shows that alternatives have not yet found sufficient traction in the local market.

Turkey market share distribution:

  • ChatGPT: 90.24%
  • Gemini: 5.62%
  • Perplexity: 2.02%
  • Copilot: 1.57%
  • Claude: 0.55%

Competition and Technical Preferences

In ChatGPT’s leadership, its continuously updated model structure and the integration of browser-like features such as ChatGPT Atlas are proving effective. Although Google has taken steps for Gemini such as free AI Pro memberships and ecosystem integration, users generally treat Gemini as a secondary tool.

On the other hand, although its overall market share appears low, Claude has a significant place especially among software developers. It continues to be preferred by technical teams for code reading, debugging, and working with large context windows. However, this technical niche has a limited impact on overall market share data.
